problem:

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,Q∨¬(P∨Q)\,$ | $\,¬P∨Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |

Using your results, complete the following statement:

$$
Q∨¬(P∨Q){{field-4}}¬P∨Q
$$

feedback.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,C\,$ | $\,¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C\,$ | $\,¬C∧(A∨C)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Using your results, complete the following statement:

$$
¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C{{field-4}}¬C∧(A∨C)
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's solve for the missing values:

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $C≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬C∧(A∨C) & ≡¬\text{T}∧(\text{T}∨\text{T}) \\  & ≡\text{F}∧\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{T}$ and $C≡\text{F},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬C∧(A∨C) & ≡¬\text{F}∧(\text{T}∨\text{F}) \\  & ≡\text{T}∧\text{T} \\  & ≡\text{T}\end{aligned}
$$

- When $A≡\text{F}$ and $C≡\text{T},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C & ≡¬(¬\text{F}∧¬\text{T})∧¬\text{T} \\  & ≡¬(\text{T}∧\text{F})∧\text{F} \\  & ≡¬\text{F}∧\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{T}∧\text{F} \\  & ≡\text{F}\end{aligned}
$$

Our completed table is shown below.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,C\,$ | $\,¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C\,$ | $\,¬C∧(A∨C)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

To determine whether $¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C$ is logically equivalent to $¬C∧(A∨C),$ we need to check whether their truth tables are equivalent.  

Looking at the last two columns, we see that they are the same $(\text{F},\text{T},\text{F},\text{F}).$ Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
¬(¬A∧¬C)∧¬C≡¬C∧(A∨C).
$$
